name: big_jump
action_prompt: Front view only. The duck crouches down clearly and deeply. Then it makes one very high joyful vertical jump. Both feet clearly leave the ground. Both wings rise high during the jump. At the top of the jump, the duck looks very happy. Then the duck lands on both feet, the body compresses slightly, makes one cute soft bounce, and returns to the same front-facing standing pose as at the beginning.

name: flapping_celebration
action_prompt: Front view only. The duck stays on the ground and celebrates by flapping both wings very widely and rapidly. The whole body sways side to side with excitement. No jumping.

name: fast_happy_steps
action_prompt: Three-quarter front view. The duck happily does very fast alternating foot taps in place. The body bounces rhythmically. End with one foot slightly lifted.

name: full_spin
action_prompt: Full-body view. The duck performs one energetic 360-degree spin, clearly showing front, side, back, opposite side, and front again. End facing front.

name: tail_wiggle
action_prompt: Back view only. The duck wiggles its rounded tail and hips left and right several times, then looks back over one shoulder toward the viewer with a pleased expression.

name: victory_pose
action_prompt: Front view only. The duck dramatically raises both wings high overhead like a victory pose and bounces the whole body twice without leaving the ground. End smiling with both wings up.

name: cheerful_step_dance
action_prompt: Side view only. The duck performs an exaggerated cheerful stepping dance with alternating high steps. No jumping. End in a lively pose with one foot forward.

name: run_toward_camera
action_prompt: Front-facing depth movement. The duck starts a little farther away, then runs enthusiastically straight toward the camera, becoming larger as it approaches, and stops before leaving the frame.

name: lying_kick_flap
action_prompt: Three-quarter full-body view. The duck lies on its back and happily kicks both feet and flaps both wings wildly, rolling slightly from side to side, then pauses in a spread-out happy pose.

name: proud_pose
action_prompt: Three-quarter front view. The duck takes one confident step forward, puffs out its chest dramatically, lifts its chin slightly, and ends in a proud pose.

name: full_body_laugh
action_prompt: Three-quarter front view. The duck suddenly bursts into laughter, leans far backward, then bends forward while laughing, then leans back again. End in a big laughing pose.

name: rolling_laugh
action_prompt: Side view only. The duck laughs so hard that it loses balance, falls sideways, rolls once on the ground, and ends lying on its back still laughing.

name: tears_of_laughter
action_prompt: Front view only. The duck laughs loudly while swinging its whole body dramatically left and right. Large tears fly outward from both eyes.

name: giggle_cover_mouth
action_prompt: Three-quarter front view. The duck covers its mouth with one wing and quietly giggles, bending forward slightly and shaking the shoulders. Then it glances toward the viewer.

name: big_clap
action_prompt: Front view only. The duck makes three large exaggerated claps with both wings. Keep both feet on the ground. End with both wings together at the chest.

name: self_hug
action_prompt: Front view only. The duck wraps both wings around its own body in a tight self-hug and sways happily from side to side.

name: pull_to_chest
action_prompt: Three-quarter front view. The duck reaches both wings forward as if receiving something precious, then pulls it dramatically toward the chest and holds it lovingly. Do not generate any object.

name: come_for_hug
action_prompt: Front view only. The duck starts slightly farther away, opens both wings very wide, and rushes toward the camera as if coming in for a hug. Stop before reaching the camera.

name: squish_cheeks
action_prompt: Front view only. The duck raises both wings to its face, squeezes both cheeks, then tilts its head right and left with a delighted expression.

name: spin_and_pose
action_prompt: Start facing away from the viewer. The duck spins around quickly through side and three-quarter views, then faces front and finishes with one wing raised and one foot forward in a cheerful pose.

name: frozen_shock
action_prompt: Front view only. The duck suddenly jolts in surprise, opens its wings slightly, widens the eyes and mouth, and then becomes completely frozen with only a tiny trembling motion.

name: step_back_in_shock
action_prompt: Three-quarter front view. The duck recoils backward in shock and takes three large alternating steps backward while holding both wings forward defensively.

name: astonished_wings_open
action_prompt: Front view only. The duck briefly compresses its body, then suddenly spreads both wings to maximum width and leans the head and chest dramatically backward in astonishment. Hold the pose.

name: look_left_right
action_prompt: Front view only. The duck rapidly looks left, right, left, and right. Rotate not only the head but slightly the whole torso. Finish facing front with both wings slightly open.

name: anxious_turning
action_prompt: Full-body view. The duck nervously tries to move right, suddenly changes direction left, then right again, and makes a confused half-turn while flapping the wings anxiously.

name: panic_hold_head
action_prompt: Front view only. The duck quickly raises both wings to the sides of its head, holds the head in panic, crouches deeply, and sways the whole body left and right.

name: dizzy_stagger
action_prompt: Three-quarter front view. The duck staggers dramatically like it is dizzy, leaning far right and far left, awkwardly crossing the feet while trying to keep balance.

name: fall_on_bottom
action_prompt: Front view only. The duck suddenly recoils in shock, lifts both feet forward slightly, and falls heavily onto its bottom. End sitting on the ground with a stunned expression.

name: run_away
action_prompt: Side view only. The duck glances backward in fear, then sprints extremely fast across the screen with exaggerated long leg movements and wings trailing backward.

name: hard_brake
action_prompt: Side view only. The duck begins running fast, suddenly brakes hard with both feet extended forward, pitches the upper body forward, nearly falls face-first, then flaps its wings to recover balance.

name: cry_loudly
action_prompt: Front view only. The duck suddenly begins crying loudly, opens the mouth wide, releases large visible tears from both eyes, and bounces the entire body strongly up and down while sobbing.

name: sit_and_sob
action_prompt: Three-quarter front view. The duck slowly lowers the body, sits on the ground, brings both wings inward, bows the head slightly, and quietly sobs with small shoulder movements.

name: collapse_flat
action_prompt: Side view only. The duck gradually loses all strength, lowers the head, buckles the legs, and collapses belly-first onto the ground until the entire body lies flat and exhausted.

name: sad_walk
action_prompt: Side view only. The duck walks slowly across the screen with the head hanging low, feet dragging, wings hanging loosely, and a deeply discouraged posture.

name: turn_away_and_sulk
action_prompt: Start facing front. The duck slowly turns its entire body 180 degrees away from the viewer, crouches with the back facing the camera, briefly glances back over one shoulder, then turns away again.

name: wipe_tears
action_prompt: Front view only. The duck wipes one eye strongly with the right wing, wipes the other eye with the left wing, then covers the face with both wings before revealing a sad expression.

name: slow_collapse
action_prompt: Front view only. The duck gradually loses strength from head to feet, lets the wings droop, bends the knees, and slowly collapses straight downward into a seated exhausted pose.

name: big_yawn_and_stretch
action_prompt: Three-quarter front view. The duck makes one huge yawn, stretches both wings high overhead, rises onto the toes, and elongates the entire body upward in a dramatic full-body stretch.

name: dozing_off_standing
action_prompt: Front view only. The duck becomes sleepy while standing, slowly tilts the head right, recovers, tilts left, recovers again, then lets the head fall forward and gently sways.

name: lie_down_sleep
action_prompt: Side view only. The duck makes a large yawn, crouches down, curls its body, lies down on the ground, and immediately falls asleep. End with a subtle breathing motion.

name: stomp_one_foot
action_prompt: Front view only. The duck angrily raises one foot high and stomps the ground hard twice. Let the whole body bounce slightly with each impact.

name: spread_wings_threat
action_prompt: Front view only. The duck briefly compresses the body, suddenly spreads both wings to maximum width, puffs out the chest, and takes one intimidating step toward the viewer.

name: trembling_anger
action_prompt: Front view only. The duck trembles rapidly with the entire body in restrained anger, keeping both wings tight against the sides, then suddenly stops and glares at the viewer.

name: thrust_beak_forward
action_prompt: Three-quarter front view. The duck thrusts the head, neck, chest, and beak aggressively forward and takes two strong steps toward the camera, ending very close to the viewer.

name: angry_protest
action_prompt: Front view only. The duck swings the right wing dramatically forward, then the left wing, alternating several times while twisting the torso in angry protest.

name: turn_head_hmph
action_prompt: Front view only. The duck keeps the torso facing forward but sharply turns only the head to one side in a strong hmph motion, partially returns, then turns away again.

name: turn_back_completely
action_prompt: Start facing front. The duck makes a small angry stomp, then rotates the entire body 180 degrees and finishes with the back fully facing the viewer.

name: shake_head_no
action_prompt: Front view only. The duck shakes the head very strongly left and right several times in a clear refusal gesture. Let the torso follow slightly, then finish facing front with both wings held forward.

name: march_away_angry
action_prompt: Three-quarter rear view. The duck angrily turns away from the viewer and marches toward the edge of the frame with exaggerated heavy stomping steps and forceful wing movements.

name: hands_on_hips_pose
action_prompt: Front view only. The duck places both wings firmly at its sides like hands on hips, spreads the feet wide, puffs out the chest, leans slightly forward, and makes one assertive step toward the viewer.

name: deep_bow
action_prompt: Front view only. The duck stands straight facing the viewer, keeps both wings neatly alongside the body, bows very deeply forward until the top of the head is clearly visible, briefly holds the bow, then returns upright.

name: strong_nod
action_prompt: Front view only. The duck makes three very strong exaggerated nods using not only the head but the chest and whole upper body. Keep both feet on the ground and finish with one deep decisive nod.

name: tilt_head_curious
action_prompt: Front view only. The duck tilts the head and upper body dramatically to the right, returns to center, then tilts dramatically to the left, ending with a curious expression and slightly open wings.

name: sneak_walk
action_prompt: Side view only. The duck sneaks forward quietly with exaggerated high, slow steps while keeping the body low and leaning slightly forward. Pause with one foot lifted as if checking whether anyone noticed.

name: peek_over_shoulder
action_prompt: Back view only. The duck keeps the back facing the viewer, slowly peeks over one shoulder, hides again, then peeks over the opposite shoulder. Finish with only part of the face visible.

name: point_with_wing
action_prompt: Three-quarter front view. The duck suddenly notices something off to one side, turns the gaze toward it, stretches one wing strongly in that direction, and leans the entire body toward the discovered point. Use the natural duck wing, not a human hand or finger.

name: slip_and_fall
action_prompt: Side view only. The duck begins walking normally, suddenly slips one foot forward, slides both feet out in front, spreads both wings widely while losing balance, and falls heavily onto its bottom.

name: chase_tail
action_prompt: Full-body view. The duck notices its own tail, turns the head backward, then chases the tail in a small fast circular path for about two rotations before stopping slightly dizzy.

name: shake_dry
action_prompt: Front view only. The duck performs an exaggerated full-body shake like a duck drying itself. Start the shake at the head and let the movement travel visibly through the neck, torso, hips, and tail like a wave. Finish by spreading the wings once.

name: sprint_across_frame
action_prompt: Side view only. The duck suddenly sprints into the frame from the left, races across the entire screen at very high speed with long exaggerated strides and wings trailing backward, then exits toward the right.
